name: ui-reuse-audit
description: Audit frontend UI reuse, consumer availability, and ownership before implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Audit UI reuse and ownership before implementation.
interface.longDescription: Inspect the current consumer, shared UI sources, adapters, Figma mappings, and versioned dependencies before frontend implementation. Classify each material UI capability as reuse, adapter, composition, design-system extension, or application-specific while keeping availability and missing external contracts separate.
defaultPrompt: Audit this UI task for reuse and ownership before implementation.
Verify what the current consumer can actually use before relying on upstream design-system capability.
Classify material UI capabilities and separate version gaps or missing routes, APIs, and actions from ownership.
